title: Isao prints the companions: neither is on the planet at landing; C-07 is printed at the first quiet moment after the handover, RECKON K9 three days later once the radar stands, each in a skippable live close-up through four angles
context: Owner, 2026-10-30, a playtest of ed18be84: "the robot cat should not already be on the planet when we land, let's spawn it after; include a skippable scene where Isao whimsically prints the cat because he wants a companion. Close up on the creation, showing various angles." and "same with the Cheetah later." Since 2026-10-27 (entry 2026-10-27-c07-and-reckon-k9-the-base-companions) both stood on the clearing from the first frame. The wording is ambiguous: C-07 IS the mechanical cheetah, so 'the robot cat' and 'the Cheetah later' name the same unit; the second note is read as the other companion (RECKON K9) printed later the same way. The order is a content knob so the owner can swap it with one line. The FEIDS-26 drop is the model: a pure timeline and camera rule in src/domain, the scene in src/fx, the host literal in td-tab, a live shot with 5 s mandatory then Space (src/fx/camera-shot.js lockFor / skipKey).
outcome: 1) src/content/companions.js COMPANIONS.prints: order ['c07', 'k9'] (swap the two ids to print the dog first; the triggers stay by position) and one trigger per print: the first at the story beat 'expedition' (the handover done: the Stålheart up, the hull the player's, the sites shown) + 20 s, the second at 'expedition' + perk 'uplink' (the radar, sector 2's step) + 3 in-game days after the first was born + 10 s; then the first quiet moment (no shot, seat, card, controls page or line of Isao's, the hull alive, no win, not the arena, the sector in a breath or secure or not begun), a fight no longer holding it after `patience` 150 s. COMPANIONS.print: the bed 2-4 hops from the heart clear of the solid structures, of the hull's keep-off and of every raised island slab by 8, then 4, then 0 m (slabClear), 1.9 m radius, Isao's foot 2.4 m over the body, the print colour, the fresh band 0.12, the timeline arrive 1.6 / print 9 / skin 1.4 / wake 3.5 s (15.5 s), four camera angles in the bed's metres (wide three-quarter front with Isao over the bed; beside and a little over along the rising flank; low in front looking up past the head to the beam; three-quarter rear round to the side as it wakes), scaled by the body's length, the shot 'petPrint' (lock 5 s, Space, 'SPACE · SKIP', the near plane 0.00025 as the drop's). Units carry their waking line (born). 2) src/domain/pet-print.js (pure): nextPrint (strict order), printGates, printReady, printEnd, printTimeline (the phases, the print's cut, the skin's a band lower, the unit held until it wakes, Isao down and back up), printCamera. 3) src/fx/pet-print.js: the scene: the bed (a dark disc, three glowing rings), the print (the unit's fixture again as a bright wireframe held at its idle's first frame, cut by a rising clipping plane), the unit's own tinted wireframe revealed by a second plane a band lower (materials cloned, handed back), a glowing slice sheet at the cut, Isao held off his queue (isao.held, as the missile's set piece) hovering over the bed with his head's beam rastering the slice, the live cut with the lowered lens and a snap at each angle change, the hint after the lock; the end or a skip finishes at once: the unit born, its idle playing, Isao back to his work (his flight resumes from where he is unless he was printing), the bed fading. 4) src/fx/companions.js: each unit 'unborn' (loaded, hidden, out of the play and the radar) -> 'printing' (on the bed facing the heart, the near tier, held still) -> 'born'; spots(cells, padM), print, wake, birth, life, born; ?pets=born keeps the old first-frame behaviour (the --companions step uses it). src/domain/companion-play.js: ctx.present(i): an unprinted unit's record is left alone, no game of tag without both. 5) src/fx/story-base.js slabAt(p, padM): the top of a grown island under a unit point (the first runs printed beside a slab and its edge hid the bed). 6) td-tab: the host after the companions', ticked with them, 'petPrint' in the live shots, state().companions.print, harness petPrint(i), the terminal's world names the printed (bestiary need 'pet': c07 / k9 on the books once printed). 7) Isao's lines, captions only: pet_print_first, pet_print_second, pet_born_c07 (with the one science-fiction nod: electric gazelles), pet_born_k9.
alternatives: Keep C-07 as 'the robot cat' and read 'the Cheetah later' as a third unit: there is no third model; the order knob makes either reading one line.

Print on a fixed timer from landing: the opening is a scripted tutorial with its own shots and closeups; the handover beat ('expedition') is the first point the player has the hull and nothing is scripted over it.
A hard cut between angles only through the game camera's glide (lerp 0.14 a frame): it read as a swoop through the base; the scene snaps the camera at each angle change.

A raycast for the floor under the bed: a Sprite in the scene threw without raycaster.camera and the whole scene's triangles would be walked per candidate; the plan's island plots answer it exactly (slabAt).
Requiring Isao idle before the print: he prints for minutes at a time in the opening; the set piece's hold freezes his job and he resumes it after.
evidence: npm test 311 (new test/pet-print.mjs: the order and triggers, strict order and the swapped order, the gates (beat, perk, days), printReady's holds and patience and force, the timeline's phases and monotonic cuts with the band, the four angles in order eased in their spans and scaled; test/companions.mjs: an unprinted unit stays out of the play and tag waits for both; test/bestiary-units.mjs: the 'pet' need), npm run check (td-tab 5,353 under 5,450), npm run architecture green. npm run build not run in the worktree (no node_modules: gltfpack missing).

--pet-print PASS (skip=defence base): both unborn at load; the first did not come on its own in 45 s (why 'fight': sector 1's first pulse, no breath yet) and was forced; the cut 'petPrint' with near 0.00025, Isao held over the bed (foot 3.2-3.4 m up, 6.3 m tall); a plain K inside the lock left it; frames at t 2.6 / 6.3 / 9.9 / 12.7 s, angles 0-3, eye 14.1 / 3.0 / 3.1 / 3.9 m (artifacts/browser/pet-print-1..4.png); the hint after the lock; Space at 12.8 s: C-07 born, Watch_Idle playing, lens and hint gone, then off into its play (greet at 1.3 m/s on the gallop); K9 held by its gates ('gates'), forced, ran to its end 15.5 s unskipped and was born (pet-print-k9.png at 1.8 m).

Frames judged: run one showed the cheetah far and the bed absent; the eye distances measured right (3-14 m), the bed had been placed beside a raised island slab whose edge hid it (and in K9's frame cut the dog in two); with slabClear the bed sits on bare floor and every angle frames it: Isao's face over the glowing bed, the legs rising through the slice sheet, the body half-printed from the front under the beam, the finished tinted cheetah on its rings.
--companions PASS with ?pets=born (70 game s: c07 eight modes, k9 six, tops 7 and 5.5 m/s, a game of tag and a tag, 0 samples off the roam).
